purpose: The integrator flip of CT03 proof stage: the manifest third executed proof row, superseding the wave-3 CT-integration record for CT03 without editing it (constraint 21). Every other stage row is carried from that record unchanged; only proof moves, on the named workspace test the capability card landed.
derivation_rule: A stage is executed only where a named workspace test runs it on the case own artifact. compiler/tests/ct03_proof_leg.rs lowers CT03 fixture through the real pipeline and checks the artifact against the Lean-proved procedure over the extended alphabet. A grown proof numerator is evidence about this case artifact, not language conformance (constraint 23).

task_lowering.note: qcore_frontend::source_tasks lowering of `read PLACE share N` captures and `qcore_buffer_write`, reached through compile_files.

task_ledger_check.note: qcore_core::scoped_tasks all-paths check, reached through compile_files; the harness asserts SourceExecutionProfile::ScopedReadSharesV1 so another route cannot satisfy the case.

task_reference_execution.note: execute_task_module_with_worker_allocations on the checked task IR, once per fixed schedule; it never reads the emitted C.

c_emission.note: one emitted module, compiled once per schedule.

native_execution.note: the emitted C compiled and run once per schedule; stdout equals the reference observation line for line on the two completing schedules, and the trapped-abort schedule pins what its truncated observation must not contain.

native_sanitized.note: ASan + UBSan on every schedule; LeakSanitizer on every schedule whose exit code is 0. Gated by the harness, not a transcript.

proof.note: the artifact checked against the Lean-proved decision procedure of QCore.Ct03ReadShares over the CT03-PROOF-ALPHABET extension of the F02 relation (QCore.TaskTraceWrites), registered in AuditCt03ReadShares.lean; reference run decided by kernel and every admitted rendering covered by the symbolic closure. The alphabet extension is proved CONSERVATIVE (write_free_traces_relate_exactly_as_before) and no existing digest moved. Native execution deliberately not covered (observation only); typed error outcomes remain outside the alphabet.
